const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Interactive controller for the single RoboLab mustard episode.
+
+Run this file once, then send one JSON command per stdin line. Images are saved
+under /app/output/frames for inspection. No command resets the service.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import traceback
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+from rcb_client import Robot
+from requests.exceptions import RequestException
+
+OUT = "/app/output"
+os.makedirs(os.path.join(OUT, "frames"), exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print("SPEC " + json.dumps(spec, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+
+
+def record(label, result):
+    for cam, arr in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(arr)).save(
+            os.path.join(OUT, "frames", f"{label}_{cam}.jpg"), quality=94
+        )
+    if result.last_depth:
+        for cam, arr in result.last_depth.items():
+            np.save(os.path.join(OUT, "frames", f"{label}_{cam}_depth.npy"), arr)
+    return {
+        "meta": result.meta,
+        "proprio": result.meta.get("proprio"),
+        "last_cameras": list(result.last),
+        "last_depth_cameras": list(result.last_depth),
+        "frames": {k: len(v) for k, v in result.frames.items()},
+    }
+
+
+def call(label, fn):
+    try:
+        res = fn()
+    except RequestException as e:
+        print(f"CONNECTION_ERROR {type(e).__name__}: {e}", flush=True)
+        try:
+            st = r.wait_ready()
+            print("RESUMED_STATUS " + json.dumps(st), flush=True)
+        except Exception as e2:
+            print(f"WAIT_READY_ERROR {type(e2).__name__}: {e2}", flush=True)
+        return
+    print("RESULT " + json.dumps(record(label, res), separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+    try:
+        print("STATUS " + json.dumps(r.status(), separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"STATUS_ERROR {type(e).__name__}: {e}", flush=True)
+
+
+initial = r.get_obs(video="frames", depth=True)
+print("INITIAL " + json.dumps(record("initial", initial), separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+print("STATUS " + json.dumps(r.status(), separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    line = line.strip()
+    if not line:
+        continue
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        op = cmd["op"]
+        label = cmd.get("label", f"step_{r.status().get('control_steps', 0)}")
+        if op == "quit":
+            print("BYE", flush=True)
+            break
+        elif op == "obs":
+            call(label, lambda: r.get_obs(video="frames", depth=cmd.get("depth", True)))
+        elif op == "watch":
+            call(label, lambda: r.get_obs(seconds=float(cmd["seconds"]), video="both",
+                                          video_fps=int(cmd.get("fps", 10)),
+                                          depth=cmd.get("depth", "none")))
+        elif op == "joint":
+            call(label, lambda: r.submit("joint_position", cmd["actions"],
+                                         dt=float(cmd.get("dt", 1 / 15)),
+                                         video=cmd.get("video", "mp4"),
+                                         video_fps=cmd.get("fps", 10),
+                                         depth=cmd.get("depth", "none"), note=cmd.get("note", "")))
+        elif op == "ee":
+            call(label, lambda: r.submit("ee_pose", cmd["actions"],
+                                         video=cmd.get("video", "mp4"),
+                                         video_fps=cmd.get("fps", 10),
+                                         depth=cmd.get("depth", "none"), note=cmd.get("note", "")))
+        elif op == "ik":
+            out = r.ik(cmd["targets"], seed=cmd.get("seed"), **cmd.get("opts", {}))
+            print("IK " + json.dumps(out, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+        elif op == "fk":
+            out = r.fk(cmd["q"], links=cmd.get("links"))
+            print("FK " + json.dumps(out, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+        elif op == "status":
+            print("STATUS " + json.dumps(r.status(), separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+        else:
+            print(f"UNKNOWN_OP {op}", flush=True)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"COMMAND_ERROR {type(e).__name__}: {e}", flush=True)
+        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stdout)
+        sys.stdout.flush()
*** End Patch";
const r=await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
